subject: Air freight quote to RUH
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you quote the fastest air freight option to RUH (Riyadh, SA) and let me know the earliest arrival you can offer?

We have 7 pieces of automotive sensors, with a gross weight of 970 kg and a total volume of 9.06 cbm. The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27. We’ll need you to arrange the truck from our warehouse to the airport.

Could you send me an all-in price in EUR, including pickup?

Thanks for checking!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
